steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: After the Bureau riots, many Sinners fled into the Syndicate Control Zone in the west, which sparked off major riots. There has been a surge in incidents and a rising death toll.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau</color> has confirmed the whereabouts of the mastermind behind the Bureau riot—<color=#fb9259>Suspect R</color>—in the Syndicate...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...And is willing to provide you with intelligence, but first they need MBCC to solve the crisis in Syndicate right now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is an extremely dangerous <color=#fb9259>classified mission</color>, which requires you to lead a team of Sinners to infiltrate the destination, contact the local security precinct, and arrest the target Sinners to bring the situation under control.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Why isn't the Public Security Bureau stepping in?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Because that is the gangsters' territory—<color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color>.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That is the gangsters' territory—<color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color>.
Boom—

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Get down!
The local security precinct that has promised to support you is just ahead. Its grand gates have already been blasted down. Nearly a hundred gangs are fighting right under its nose.

As far as the eye can see, all the streets descend into chaos and madness. In the air is the mixture of sounds of gunfire, maniacal laughter, and wailing, while the smell of blood and smoke permeates the streets.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That's right. Screw the *** Public Security Bureau. We don't need to give a damn when we fight.
She picks up a pipe and sends a grenade flying high with a swing, which explodes into blazing fireworks and draws the attention of the rioters.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew—Ha—Fresh air! What I'm most familiar with.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Lackeys—Welcome to Syndicate!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Syndicate is the poorest and most chaotic area of the DisCity, a gang haven and lawless place that has continuously spread violence and chaos to the entire city throughout these twenty years, and the control measures have never been effective.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Eventually, the city council was forced to sign the <color=#fb9259>West District Order Management regulations</color>, which basically allowed the gangs' autonomy outside the law to alleviate the many social concerns caused by Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Bluntly put, the <color=#fb9259>gangs</color> are the real rulers of Syndicate. They make the rules and the authorities have no say in it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahem, let me translate: Where did this beautiful lady come from? Is she really our enemy? Do we have to kill her? What a shame!
This nonsense translation sparks off even more rage and anger. They come at you again with their weapons.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Uh-oh. They're getting excited. Chief, brace yourself. Your first show is about to begin.
The Sinner girl tilts her head and gives you a bright grin.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'll try to keep you alive for a bit longer.
